purpose: Source-separated audit matrix. Wild feeding observations are descriptive and never converted directly into captive percentages, unlimited feeding, or nutrition completeness claims.

iftime_ibera_dobrogea_2012.supports: Direct evidence that wild T. g. ibera consumed reported plant taxa/parts; study reports over 95% plant matter and 25 plant species consumed.
iftime_ibera_dobrogea_2012.does_not_support: Captive diet percentages, unlimited feeding, exact portions, nutritional completeness, or safety of unobserved congeners.

mitrevichin_ibera_bulgaria_2023.supports: Direct field observations of T. g. ibera feeding on Cichorium intybus, Taraxacum sp., Medicago sp., Sedum rubens, Sedum album and Potentilla sp.
mitrevichin_ibera_bulgaria_2023.does_not_support: Quantitative captive frequency, exact portion, unlimited feeding, or inference to every species in the same genus.

slimani2006.sample_context: faecal analysis with plant availability comparison
slimani2006.supports: Direct T. g. graeca feeding ecology. Malva parviflora was among five main plant species; the five together represented about 70% of identified material. The study identified 34 plant species in the diet.
slimani2006.does_not_support: Exact Ibera evidence, Korean retail-name mapping, captive percentages, or safety of all Malva/Medicago/Astragalus species.

algeria_graeca_food_choice_2008.sample_context: 4422 plant/animal fragments from faecal pellets of 20 males, 16 females and 8 juveniles
algeria_graeca_food_choice_2008.supports: Broad wild T. graeca feeding ecology; 13 dicot and 3 monocot plant species were consumed and vegetative tissues exceeded reproductive tissues.
algeria_graeca_food_choice_2008.does_not_support: Exact Ibera evidence or safety/frequency of a Korean retail plant without a taxon-level match.

USDA_FDC.verification_basis: official FoodData Central downloadable JSON reconciled in data/plant_nutrition_v56.json
USDA_FDC.supports: Descriptive nutrient composition for an exact food/part/state record.
USDA_FDC.does_not_support: Tortoise safety, feeding frequency, diet role, ideal ratio, or evidence grade.

RDA_NICS_FCDB_10_4.supports: Korean composition only after exact food name, edible part and preparation state are reconciled.
RDA_NICS_FCDB_10_4.does_not_support: A match based only on a similar Korean retail name; tortoise feeding verdicts.

foods.audit_interpretation: Strong direct applicability for occurrence in the natural diet of T. g. ibera. It does not establish daily, unlimited, or sole-staple captive use.
